prior_result: Root E11 rejects H-A-3: zero certificates, <0.002 zero-discovery fraction in every frozen cell; no skip-threshold rescue.

evidence.summary_limits: Unpinned instrumented aggregate stages; no production QPS, cache, bandwidth or instruction inference. All256 profiles per dataset are summarized by this existing artifact; no new archive calculation was run.

primitive_accounting.llama: ~7.84ns instrumented adjacency phase per read edge;~14.10ns combined scoring/pool per unique scored row;257 serial expansion boundaries. Existing split cannot identify gather stalls versus branch/instruction work.
primitive_accounting.yi: ~6.08ns adjacency per read edge;~16.83ns combined scoring/pool per unique scored row;513 expansion boundaries. The previous125expansions×60ns model was inappropriate for these measured workloads.
primitive_accounting.new_unit: Packet of8 distinct neighbor IDs: one8-lane visited-word gather, bit test, conflict mask, stable fresh-ID compaction and scatter; same-word collisions use unchanged scalar insertion. A whole expanded list then uses the already implemented score_fresh_batch and insert_batch.
primitive_accounting.query_independence: Packetization uses only corpus adjacency/current query visited state; no adaptation to observed benchmark queries. No precomputed query outputs.
primitive_accounting.memory: Retain existing N/8-byte visited bitset and touched-word reset, plus bounded packet scratch. Avoid4N-byte epoch array, which would increase scratch32x and change cache residency.

prior_art.finding: Intel describes gather/update/scatter dependency handling using conflict detection. Direct scatter of independently updated duplicate word addresses loses updates; scalar collision fallback is exact and must be counted.
Primary optimization manual documents indirect read/write loop conflicts. It does not establish WARM speedup or guarantee target-host gather performance.

reuse_and_rejections.finding: Existing Marks::insert already uses one-bit visited storage and touched-word reset; proposed difference is8-lane packet admission, not a new visited contract.
experimental-neighbor-admission only specializes/inlines the same scalar path; it does not implement SIMD visited packets.
Existing insert_batch retains worst-threshold filtering, scalar fallback for<8 candidates, sorted merge and expanded-flag preservation. Reuse it.
Existing score_fresh_batch combines est4 with insert_batch; no new four-row scorer or second queue implementation.
Per-edge residual neighbor blocks were already negative0.76–0.79x and16x index memory in example; do not rediscover copied-neighbor quantization.
Earlier sorted-pool replacement versus heaps did not win on that host. This limits confidence in queue-only improvements; proposed composition must independently meet its cost budget.

Separate sampled Llama100k profile identifies memmove/Pool::insert and expansion closure, but categories overlap and this host/config differs. Do not sum those percentages into the Yi/Llama stage model.

model.formula: T_new = T_old * (1 - A - S + A/3 + S/2) + 5us, where A and S are each dataset's existing phase shares
assumptions: Existing batch merge plus packet delivery reduces combined scoring/pool cost2x
Pinned target-host execution does not invalidate measured phase proportions
model.measured_vs_inferred: Only original times/counts are measured. All new costs and speedups are conditional conjectures requiring rejection tests.

gap_accounting.formula: For target2C and baselineW, closure=(G-1)W/(2C-W). G>=1.91 reaches0.5 only ifW/C>=.710.
gap_accounting.status: No matched W/C is established in the inspected artifacts. Archived instrumented recall also falls below some strongest published competitor points. A numerical mission gap-closure claim is unsupported.
gap_accounting.next_decision: Root must connect an already measured comparable baseline to this conditional model before scheduling a new parser or experiment; otherwise retain conditional card and prioritize another lane. This is a scope-limited evidence limitation, not a mission blocker.

validation: No new counter code, profiler, build, test or benchmark was written or run. Changes are limited to next-card-4.md and this research file.
